summary: Maris-Tech Ltd. furnished a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) on September 29, 2026, disclosing completion of development of Diamond Ultra V2, its next-generation video and AI platform based on the Dragonwing IQ9 Series, targeted at defense, homeland security, counter-UAS and airborne applications. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation or advisor is stated. Press release is incorporated by reference into existing Form S-8 and F-3 registration statements. This is a routine product-development disclosure and presents no special-situation or risk-arbitrage angle.
